hero.title: Historical Context: Birth of Buddha
hero.description: An analytical study of Siddhartha Gautama's origins, historical environment, and the transition from the Vedic social order to the rise of Heterodox sects.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Location: Lumbini, Terai plains of Nepal
  • Region: Foothills of the Himalayas
  • Political Unit: Shakya Gana-Sangha (Kapilavastu)

Personalities

  • Father: Suddhodana (Shakya Chief)
  • Mother: Mahamaya (Koliya Dynasty)
  • Foster Mother: Mahaprajapati Gautami

The Contextual Matrix

AspectDetail
Birth PlaceLumbini (Rummindei)
ClanShakya (Ikshvaku lineage)
Social StatusKshatriya (Gana-Sangha)

Life Events Mindmap

  • Pre-Birth: Conception in Kapilavastu, Queen Mahamaya's dream.
  • Birth: 563 BCE, Lumbini, under a Sal tree.
  • Early Life: Prince Siddhartha, marriage to Yashodhara, birth of Rahula.
  • The Four Sights: Old man, sick man, dead body, ascetic.

Mahabhinishkramana (The Great Departure) at age 29, symbolizing the rejection of Kshatriya lifestyle.

items.title: B.L.A.D.E
items.decryption: Use this to track the early timeline: 563 BC (Birth), Lumbini (Site), 29 (Age), Mahabhinishkramana (Departure), Enlightenment (35 years).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Misidentifying Buddha's clan: He was a Shakya (Kshatriya), not a Brahmana.
Confusing Lumbini's location: It is in the Terai region of Nepal, not India, though significant in Buddhist circuit.
Thinking he belonged to a kingdom; he was from a Gana-Sangha (republican state).
